thread:
erin: During the quarterly review I found an IAM role bound to two external principals and a contractor email (left last year). Role = roles/cloudkms.admin. Need rapid cleanup but avoid breaking CI.

sam: yikes. which principals? can you paste binding or link?

erin: link: https://drive.internal/redwood/access-reviews/4070011223_bindings.txt 
binding gist: members: [user:old-contractor@vendor.com, serviceAccount:orphan@external.org, serviceAccount:ci-runner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com] role: roles/cloudkms.admin

rachel: old-contractor left 2024-06. orphan@external.org is not in allowlist. we should remove externals asap.

tom: plan: 1) create temp fallback key, 2) update CI env to use fallback during maintenance window (02:00-03:00 UTC), 3) remove external bindings, 4) rotate keys, 5) collect evidence for audit and attestation.

security-bot: policy reminder: external principals with kmsAdmin require SecEng approval. Flagged for review.

sam: I'll run a dry-run PR that removes non-allowlisted members and outputs affected keys. posting PR WIP: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/4891

ci-bot: dry-run result: 3 keys referenced, no failed ops in sandbox.

rachel: tom, can you add a temp log sink to capture PermissionDenied/errors for 48h after rotation? Will help RCA.

tom: yes. will add filter and retention 14d. will also create an oncall monitor: if >3 failed decrypts in 5m, page eng-oncall. oncall-bot, pls create monitor.

oncall-bot: created monitor "kms-rot-4070011223" -> pages eng-oncall sev2 on threshold breach.

erin: evidence bundle for SecTracker: add commit that introduced binding, last-used logs, and vendor contract proof. If SecEng approves, we remove externals in the scheduled window.

sam: noted. tagging PR with requires-sec-eng-approval. will post merge and schedule window.

rachel: if anything looks risky, mark ticket `break-risk` and rollback to env var pointing to original key.

erin: timeline: dry-run now, SecEng review today, maintenance window tonight 02:00-03:00 UTC, rotate+remove externals, monitor for 48h. If unapproved, escalate to SecEng lead.

sam: +1. will update PR and SecTracker.
